about_the_game:
Extraction Survivors: A Hybrid Genre Blending Vampire Survivors and Extraction Shooters

In this thrilling new genre, Extraction Survivors, players dive into procedurally generated, high-risk zones teeming with endless enemy hordes, combining the addictive auto-shooting chaos of Vampire Survivors with the tense loot-and-escape tension of extraction shooters like Escape from Tarkov.

Core Gameplay Loop:

  • Drop In & Survive the Horde: Enter a sprawling map solo or with a squad. Move your character (or grow a massive, evolving "survivor snake" of minions/weapons) while auto-firing an arsenal of upgradable weapons. Enemies swarm from all directions—zombies, mutants, rival operators—scaling in intensity like VS waves.

  • Loot, Level, & Evolve: Collect gems, XP orbs, and rare loot crates dropped by foes. Spend them at temporary upgrade altars to evolve weapons (e.g., whip into a holy tentacle swarm) or unlock passives. Permanent meta-progression lets you carry over blueprints for "extraction kits" across runs.

  • Risky Extraction: Survive 15-30 minutes to unlock dynamic extraction points (helicopters, trains, portals). But beware—rival players hunt you for your loot, bosses spawn mid-run, and the map collapses over time. Extract successfully to bank your haul; die, and lose it all (with a slim "insurance" recovery chance).

Key Features:

  • Roguelite Progression: Runs are short (20-45 mins) but replayable with branching builds—melee bruiser, glass cannon DPS, or tanky extractor.

  • PvE Mayhem: Fight AI hordes and players. Team up or betray at extractions.

  • Endless Customization: 50+ weapons, modular maps (urban ruins, alien labs, undead castles).

  • High Stakes Thrill: That VS "just one more level" dopamine hit, fused with Tarkov paranoia—do you push for mega-loot or bail early?

Perfect for fans craving bullet-hell survival with permadeath tension. Imagine growing an unstoppable weapon horde, only to sprint a collapsing bridge under sniper fire to escape—pure adrenaline!
